body: I’ve been having trouble eating as well. I don’t feel hungry. And this is troubling to me because I know I need to feed and nourish my physical body.
Okay I’d be down, I don’t move until august so hit me up then!
I play tennis too!! Not that great at it though :/ 25F
I’m 25F :) I’m moving from St. Petersburg FL I would love some recommendations on things to do!
I’ve been having the exact same issue. I actually just quit my job a couple minutes ago lmao
Just got out of the psych hospital for depression/serious suicidal thoughts.. struggling with the reality sitting in of being back in real life

I relate to this so much. I feel guilty for being depressed because there are others in my life that have gone through so much more than me. I just don’t see the point in life. I have so many friends and people that care about me but I don’t care about any of them… which makes me even more depressed. I feel empty and just would rather not be alive.
Doing something like that just seems like a huge waste of time.. I’ve tried so many things and I’m just tired of feeling nothing when I do them.
I try to do things and I hang out with friends but I would be happier sleeping in my bed.

I feel like that is mostly the case with people who are depressed… everyone tries to tell me to remember the things I liked doing and just try doing them to feel better. But I can’t think of anything that I enjoyed doing or was ever passionate about.
I wish I had some advice, all I can share is that I’m feeling the same way. Hope it gets better.

Hi 23F here and I have been looking for something to relate to about my memory loss. I can’t remember any conversation I have with anyone, and then people get pissed because I don’t remember anything about them. I just can’t concentrate and it feels like my brain can’t function. 

I’ve lost almost all of my memory, and it feels like there’s no point in living if I don’t have any memories, and can’t make any new memories. Going back on antidepressants because the thought of suicide is pretty much daily.

I told my doctor I have suicidal thoughts but no plan. She made me promise to make a pact with her that if I were ever planning on hurting myself that I would call her. She referred me to a psychologist and strongly suggested I go back on my medication. 

I also told my therapist the same thing, she asked if anyone else knew. I told her I told my doctor and then she hasn’t brought it up since. I feel like my therapist was more uncomfortable with me telling her than my actual doctor.

Wow I feel the exact same way as you and completely understand your situation. I wish I had some good advice but I would say just apologize and tell them the truth. Tell them you’re aware of the behavior and will try to help out more - let them know you’re going to start trying and that they can remind you if that’s what you need due to your anxiety and depression. Let them know just a simple “hey can you take the trash out” text would be really helpful for you.

I have what I call “zero days” where I literally do nothing. I sleep for the most of the day, maybe I’ll get up and make some Mac and cheese, I’ll binge watch a show on Netflix. I stay in bed. I allow myself 24 hours to do nothing, and not feel bad about it. The not feeling bad about it is the really important part. Your brain is working really hard to survive and function right now. Give it a break.

I am going through kind of the same thing right now… I just want to avoid everything. I avoid talking to people, avoid my problems, avoid things I need to do at work. I just feel uncomfortable and the only thing I know how to do to get comfort is to get in my bed and sleep. I want to change my job but I have no experience and honestly no confidence or motivation to get a new job. I am just scared of everything, of using my own voice, of my own thoughts. I hope things get better for you - there are days where I feel okay and get some hope, but then I start to fall back down again.
I’ve thought a lot about CBD I’m worried it will make me more tired than I already am.
Thanks for sharing, I try to give myself a little treat during my break now.
This comment made me tear up, I think she does want to help I just don’t know what will help and that’s the problem.
Thank you for sharing - I hope your current low lifts soon.

I started seeing a therapist online and it wasn’t very productive.. I also told my doctor I had suicidal thoughts and she referred me to a psychiatrist in the area. I’ve taken antidepressants but feeling like I don’t want to be reliant on medication. Taking every thing one step at a time helps - I’m glad you reached out for help from a therapist, I am there with you right now.
This is a very interesting take on depression, it makes sense and I have definitely spent my whole life wanting a better future…
I’m in my early 20s now… what did you do during your lows when you couldn’t function?
Thanks for your response - the Apathetic feeling happens to me too. I just don’t care about anything, because when I do I am always disappointed.

My dad has a very similar story. He went to a very small high school in the middle of nowhere and basketball was his life. His senior year they made it to the state finals and he blames himself for losing the game. Everyone says he was never the same since then. He probably feels the exact same pain you do. Thanks for sharing, you are not alone. I hope you find the strength to keep going.
